description: This file is the main index HTML page for a web-based database visualization dashboard. It contains the structure, styling, and client-side JavaScript to browse databases, tables, and view data interactively. The page loads database information via API calls and dynamically renders tables with expandable cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses database entries and loads table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of tables for selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into an HTML table structure.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates a table cell HTML based on data type and length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands/collapses cell content for long or object data.
